Migration/schema retain an intra-schema tenant_id column with no @schema_prefix, consistent with decision 0003 Decision B. apply_status_update/3's four clauses reproduce design doc req181-webhooks-core.md section 3.3's reconciliation table exactly (ACTIVE->ACTIVE and PAUSED->ACTIVE clear paused_at, PAUSED->PAUSED is an idempotent no-op, ACTIVE->PAUSED stamps a fresh paused_at). No unresolved open question in section 5 was silently implemented without comment. No type-safety gap worth filing to docs/issues/ -- status is already a closed Ecto.Enum and reconcile_status/1 resolves to one target atom before the transaction starts. No defect found.
